title: String handling
sub: Worksheet for the 360° experience: String handling
objectives: know how to find the length of a string and the character at a given position
understand how a slice takes part of a string, and why its end position is left out
know how to change case, search inside text, and move between a character and its code

exam: A program tries to print the last character of a word with print(word[len(word)]) and stops with an error. Explain why it fails, and write the line corrected.
